title: Liquidity pool asset order compared as strkey text: valid pairs refused, reversed and identical pairs accepted

target.versions_affected: v0.7.0 - v0.7.1 (executed v0.7.1); before v0.6.1 from release notes

severity_basis: A valid network transaction is refused by txnbuild and the reversed pair yields the ID of a pool stellar-core cannot create. Fixed in v0.7.2 (and backported to v0.6.1).

entries.observed: Executed on v0.7.1: txnbuild.NewLiquidityPoolId checks AssetA <= AssetB and returns an ID for a pool of an asset with itself; v0.7.2 requires AssetA < AssetB.
